name: Pauta
summary: Private, offline meeting and voice-note recorder that transcribes, summarizes and lists actions on your device.
description: Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline and keeps data on the device, connecting to external AI only if you choose. Apps are available for Mac and Windows. After the trial you can buy from the site checkout.
